column4: I'm working on this change history first. After that, the **Cleric Grudge** design and the leftover **talent description** audit are next.\n\nAnything marked "Developer build" only exists in my own test build until I say it's ready for Alpha Testers.

Every **APD setting** now starts **off** for new players (stair shortcut, adaptive search, damage-over-time panel, grass dew pickup, waterskin and known-trap confirmations, trophy outlines). Settings you already changed stay as you set them. Recording stays on, and resting still stops at full health and when starving.
The bronze, silver and gold **trophy outlines** on enemies in the dungeon are now a setting in **APD Settings > Visibility**, **off by default**. The Bestiary still shows them.
Opening **UIMSD** with a lot of history could run out of memory and crash. It now uses about a third of the memory to load, and the game can use more memory on phones that allow it.

The title screen arrow now works in every build: before **10 real runs** it says the UIMSD button is useless until then, and after that it points you to **unlimited dopamine** (or something stronger with Adult humor on).
Update notices, save warnings and the victory screen now say **ADHD Pixel Dungeon**, the title shows **v4.0.9**, and Adult humor now starts **off** for everyone.
The alchemy pot was refusing rings, so **Gemstone Dust could never be made**. Identified, uncursed rings now go in.
**Turns until Hungry** now counts the extra time from being **Well Fed**, and shows nothing while hunger is paused (tutorial, boss fights, challenge arena).

Enemies you've defeated enough times, across all your runs, get a **bronze, silver or gold outline**, in the dungeon and in the Bestiary. Normal enemies: 100 / 500 / 2,000. Bosses and rare enemies: 5 / 25 / 100. Each Bestiary entry shows your trophy and the next tier.
Once you hold the **Amulet**, every floor you enter shows its full layout, so you can see what you missed on the way up. Map only: secret doors stay hidden.

New alchemy item, the ring version of arcane resin. Dissolve an **uncursed ring** (5 energy) into **2 dust per level + 1**. Apply dust to raise an identified, uncursed ring by one level, up to **+3** (1, 2 or 3 dust).
Removed the Testing, Infrastructure and Development notes from older builds, so only changes players notice are left.

Your **hunger** shows as a number in the top-right (Hungry at 300, Starving at 450), and the status tab of your hero window always lists your hunger and **how many turns until you get Hungry**. The number turns yellow when you're Hungry and red when you're Starving.\n\nFood says exactly how much hunger it refills instead of "50% of a normal ration".
Every enchantment, glyph and the **Ring of Arcana** got plainer text. Gear shows **only the number you actually get** with your current rings, not a list of what-ifs.

Armor that's too heavy now shows **exactly what it costs you**: evasion, movement speed and armor blocking lost for each missing point of strength. Identified armor shows the exact cost. Unidentified armor shows what it would cost if it's **unupgraded**, without revealing its real level.

**Developer build only:** the in-game menu has a **Bug Note** button. Type one line about what went wrong. It's saved on the phone with the time, floor, turn, class and seed, works without service, and goes into every bug report until you clear it.
This screen! The **Changes** button opens an SPD-style history with an entry for **every recorded build**, from the earliest builds to now. Use the arrows to page through the tabs.

Tapping the **magnifying glass** now searches anywhere in a room that still has a wall that could hide a door. It used to switch to Inspect unless you were standing next to that wall.\n\nRooms whose walls can't hide anything still tap to **Inspect**, and holding the button still does the opposite.
**Developer build only:** the game asks the phone for its **highest refresh rate** (144 Hz on the RedMagic). Bug reports record the rate that was asked for.

**Crashes:**\n- Fixed an **out-of-memory crash** during play. The Cleric Grudge was building the whole statistics catalog in the background. It now counts from a small per-run summary.\n- Fixed a crash when picking up an item with a **full backpack** (the swap window was built on the wrong thread).

**Developer build only:**
- A real-world **clock** in the top-right corner.
- **Frame time** under the clock, updated every frame.
- A **stutter probe** that logs every frame slower than 100 ms, with memory in use.
- A **memory spike watcher** that records every thread when the heap jumps.

**One rule for every search control.** The toolbar button, the chooser and the resume window all decide the same way: a full search is worth its turns near a wall that could hide a door, or in a room with **visible traps**.\n\nIn a trap room, tap now always searches and reveals hidden traps instead of falling back to Inspect.

- Rebuildable statistics caches are now **gzip-compressed**, so they take much less space.\n- The diagnostic journal no longer records every drag step. It keeps the **newest 8 MiB** instead of filling to 64 MiB.\n- The trace file is no longer rewritten on every drag frame.

Bug reports can now be **Standard** or **Extended**:
- Extended reports include an **action journal** between reports: moves, attacks, waits, setting changes, scenes, errors and memory milestones. Typed text is never recorded.
- It is **Off by default**. Turning it on shows the full privacy notice first, and turning it off erases the journal.
- Extended reports are saved as a **maximum-compression ZIP**. Standard reports are unchanged.
First build with the opt-in **Extended bug report** and its action journal.

This build merges two lines of work into one game:
- **R7:** new weapons and shields, full-pack swap, throw aiming, Greater Metamorphosis and the adaptive magnifier.
- **C485:** history, diagnostics and performance work, plus the newer seed-reuse scoring.

Passed **3,540 tests** with nothing failing.

Reading saved run history is faster and uses less memory. It reuses buffers, checksums and frame storage instead of allocating new ones for every entry, and stops holding old events when a log reopens.

Replaying a seed you've already played lowers that run's score. The formula went through several versions (cubic, depth-weighted, exponential per floor, then **exact 3/5 per reuse**).\n\nAll saved runs were **corrected retroactively** to the current version.

Many fixes to importing and exporting run history:
- Damaged, aliased or oversized archives are refused **without touching your existing history**.
- Error messages stay short instead of dumping whole files.
- Imports reuse memory instead of reading everything twice.

- Markdown reports keep literal brackets, backticks and asterisks.
- ZIP exports report their real size.
- Report saving no longer leaks a file or finishes twice when a worker fails.
- Diagnostic files always stay inside their own folder.
Android **memory-pressure** warnings are kept in the bug report's heap history, including across background/resume.

**Katana family:** Tanto, Wakizashi, Tachi and Nodachi.
**Shields, tiers 1-5:** Buckler, Targe and Kite Shield.

They use their own sprites and share the normal weapon drop weight. The Katana's guard now scales with upgrades.
**Scroll of Metamorphosis** is back to the original version. **Greater Metamorphosis** is a new spell that lets you pick from any talent in the tier.
Picking up an item with a full backpack now offers to **swap** it with something you're carrying, instead of leaving it on the floor.
Thrown weapons can be aimed at **any visible enemy**, not just the closest one.

The magnifying glass picks the right action for where you are:
- **Tap:** full search near a wall that could hide a door, Inspect elsewhere.
- **Hold:** the opposite.

Rooms that can't hide a door no longer offer Wall Search or get checkmarks. Wall Search won't start on floors without hidden doors.
- The difficulty bar now fades out with the hero select screen.\n- Stale Wall Search sessions from another floor are no longer offered.

**Clearer plants, wands and food:** Ordinary plant inspection has no generic calculations button. Regrowth plants explain their rewards; Frost names its own damage reduction; food describes zero-Healing rules without hiding other benefits. Existing costs, effects and saves preserved.

**Clearer item and artifact descriptions:** Dew and Lullaby explain zero-Healing rules; Passage shows its return floor; Teleport and Remove Curse describe actual restrictions and priorities. Retained artifact details are shorter. Existing mechanics, costs, and saves preserved.

**Clearer artifacts and safe Sandals seed selection:** Shorter retained Armband, Toolkit, Hourglass and Spellbook explanations. Sandals show visible targeting and growth progress; unsupported seeds no longer crash actions or old item saves. Skeleton Key text names lock costs. Existing valid effects, costs, turns and saves preserved.

**Clearer Cloak, Rose and Talisman descriptions:** Shorter existing artifact explanations retain useful live values. Cloak distinguishes natural from external recharge. Rose explains upkeep when unequipped or magic-immune. Talisman states the maximum level. No effect, turn, save or new panel changes.

**Correct Tenacity and Vampiric descriptions:** Tenacity distinguishes protection, increased damage and a neutral ring value. Vampiric descriptions include the current healing rule without spending fractional healing credit. Concise Holy and defensive-buff wording retained. No effect, turn, save or new panel changes.

**Live blast and clear Monk descriptions:** Elemental Blast now shows actual current radius, base damage and status durations for its staff and talents. Correct basic-ward and blocked-push claims; keep ally hazard warnings. Existing Monk details are concise and Meditate resistance is explicitly empowered-only. No gameplay or new panels; audit continues.

Remove duplicate Cleric cost paragraph while preserving original live cost and retained details. No mechanics changed; audit continues.

**Clear growth and ward limits:** Shorter existing Warding and Regrowth details explain capacity, exhaustion, resin/curse infusion and temporary-level differences. Regrowth at +10 avoids a confusing integer limit. No new panels or gameplay changes; audit continues.

**Knowledge-safe weapon stats and clear healing:** Weapon and crossbow-dart inspection no longer discloses unidentified Twin Upgrades contributions; actual combat is unchanged. Clarify Eye sensing limits, Salt/Vial details and nonstacking healing. Existing panels retained; no new controls or balance changes. Audit continues.

No new panels or balance changes; individual audit continues.

Clarify Honeyed cures, remaining Battlemage staff effects and inedible raw Blandfruit. Existing Divine, Cleansing, Stamina and Mastery effects verified. No balance changes; audit continues.
